description: KEZO Hinwil: waste management capacity, Swiss recycling rates, and CO2 capture - Claims, sources and values compiled for a public guided tour of the KEZO waste-to-energy plant in Hinwil (organised by Arbeitsgruppe Energie und Umwelt Uetikon am See, 5 September 2026). Covers plant capacity (current vs. new build), Swiss national recycling rates (BAFU 2024), and the history of direct air capture at the site (Climeworks). All sourced figures carry their source; forward-looking or uncertain items are tagged 'assumed value' with a numeric confidence.

triples.name: municipal solid waste
triples.description: Siedlungsabfall; household waste plus similarly composed waste from industry and commerce. Excludes production waste, construction waste, sewage sludge and hazardous waste such as batteries

triples.name: recycling rate
triples.description: Share of municipal solid waste that is separately collected and recycled (incl. composting)

triples.name: separate collection rate
triples.description: Separatsammelquote; mass of separately collected recyclables divided by total municipal solid waste

triples.name: recovery rate
triples.description: Verwertungsquote; for beverage packaging, the recovered mass relative to the mass sold. Can exceed 100 percent due to time lag between sale and disposal and moisture gain in collected material

triples.name: incineration slag
triples.description: Schlacke; solid residue remaining after waste incineration, from which metals are recovered

triples.name: dry slag discharge
triples.description: Schlacken-Trockenaustrag; process of extracting incineration slag dry rather than quenched in water, which increases the yield of recoverable metals (Masterplan; no numeric percentage given in the source). Slag is processed at the adjacent ZAVRe facility.

triples.name: flue-gas carbon capture
triples.description: Carbon capture applied to the combustion exhaust (flue gas) of the incinerator, as opposed to capture from ambient air. Planned future use at KEZO per the 2026 masterplan

triples.name: direct air capture
triples.description: Direct Air Capture (DAC); technology that chemically filters CO2 from ambient air. Distinct from flue-gas capture, which removes CO2 from a combustion exhaust stream

triples.name: confidence value
triples.description: The p-value of an assumed value: the subjective probability between 0 and 1 that the tagged estimate is right.

triples.name: waste fee
triples.description: Abfallgebuehr; the fee charged for the disposal of the waste delivered to the plant

triples.name: waste import
triples.description: combustible waste delivered to the plant from outside its own catchment area to fill the capacity

words: open question of flue-gas carbon capture
values.description: What share of CO2 can be captured from the new KEZO plant's flue gas now and in future, and at what cost per tonne with and without permanent storage? Not addressed by available sources; flue-gas CCS technology and timing undefined in the masterplan.

Are KEZO waste fees fully cost-covering, and which areas run a deficit? What does the new build cost and who bears it? Masterplan is an urban-planning document, not a financial report. Candidate question for the guided tour.
How much additional combustible waste must be imported to the plant, and can this share be reduced in future?
How much slag and filter-ash residue remains after incineration and metal recovery, and where does it ultimately go? Slag is processed at ZAVRe; residual disposal not quantified in sources.
